tactics:
induction l generalizing l' i with
  | nil => simp [-List.getElem_zipWith] at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases l' with
    | nil => simp [-List.getElem_zipWith] at h
    | cons b t' =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ j => exact ih t' j (by simp [-List.getElem_zipWith] at h ⊢; omega)
induction l generalizing l' i <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp_all [-List.getElem_zipWith]
